map.调查多少株有代表性？: How many trees make a representative survey?
map.建议样株不少于 50 株且随机布点，分布不均时应分层抽样；样本过小发生率波动大、: At least 50 sample trees placed randomly is recommended, with stratified sampling when the distribution is uneven; too small a sample makes the incidence rate fluctuate and the class unreliable.
map.发生率能直接定防治强度吗？: Can the incidence rate directly set the control intensity?
map.不能。还需结合虫种/病害种类、发生规律与寄主价值；检疫性有害生物即使率低也须严控: No. You also need the insect or disease species, its occurrence pattern and the host value; quarantine pests must be strictly controlled even at a low rate.
